questions.question: Through the prophet who received the word of the LORD, God said the soul who sins will die for whose sin?
God said through the prophet who received His word that a wicked man who turns from all his sins will still die for them. True or false?
Through the prophet who received the word of the LORD, God said He takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked. What would He prefer for them?

answers.text: That they turn from their ways and live
That they pay for every one of their sins
That they stay far away from Israel

questions.question: When Israel said the Lord's way was not just, God replied that Israel's own ways were unjust. True or false?
